name: PandaApps
description: Native Android companion apps for Minima — eurobuddha's apps plus the official Minima app.

apps.name: PandaApps
apps.description: This store — install and update native Minima apps (SHA-256 verified). Official-app UPDATES download to your Downloads to install manually; first-time installs go direct.

apps.name: Zero Edge Casino
apps.description: Provably-fair on-chain casino — coin flip, dice and roulette via a 3-phase commit-reveal contract. Zero house edge.

apps.name: Minima UTXO Wallet
apps.description: Full UTXO wallet — send & receive, split/consolidate coins, token balances and transaction history.

apps.name: Minima History
apps.description: Browse and export your node's full transaction history, with on-chain verification.

apps.name: Minima Vestr
apps.description: Token-vesting contract manager — create and track scheduled token releases on Minima.

apps.name: FutureCash
apps.description: Send Minima or tokens to the future — lock funds until a block you choose; the recipient collects when it matures. Interoperable with the FutureCash MiniDapp.

apps.name: Minima Limit
apps.description: On-chain limit-order DEX for MINIMA/USDT — place buy & sell orders at your price; trustless full-fill swaps via a VERIFYOUT smart contract. Good-till-cancelled orders auto-renew so they never expire. Shares the same order book as the Limit MiniDapp.

apps.name: minimaSwap
apps.description: Trustless cross-chain atomic swaps between native MINIMA and Ethereum USDT — HTLC hash-locked, no custodian. Makers publish a DEPTH LADDER (up to 6 bid + 6 ask tranches, each its own price and size) and takers can MARKET-SWEEP — a large order fills best-price-first across multiple levels/makers as sequential atomic swaps, with a transparent avg/worst-price review. Aggregated on-chain order book, per-take cap matching, embedded ETH wallet, both directions, background swap watcher, and a network-wide trade history. Interoperable with the miniSwap/bridge MiniDapp. An OTC tab for negotiated peer-to-peer deals — LPs advertise side+size, an instigator proposes/counters/accepts over a sealed channel, and the deal settles as a trustless HTLC swap. AUTO MARKET-MAKE — peg your maker ladder to the live MEXC MINIMA/USDT market: it auto-reprices when the market moves and auto-withdraws for safety if the feed goes down, restoring on recovery. NEW (0.17.0): your published market now stays LIVE until you cancel it — the app self-heals after reboots, node restarts and deep sleep (pairing retry, publish verification against the on-chain book, Doze-proof heartbeat) and alerts you if Minima Core is down so the market can be reinstated the moment connection returns. Now under the com.eurobuddha namespace — this is a NEW app id, so uninstall any old minimaSwap install first (finish open swaps before switching).

apps.name: Minima ETH Wallet
apps.description: Standalone Ethereum/ERC20 wallet sharing minimaSwap's address — manage tokens, send/receive (QR), add any ERC20 by contract address, live gas preview, view activity on Etherscan. Same address via node-pair or one-time key import.

apps.name: Minima Expert
apps.description: Offline, on-device Minima knowledge expert — ask about the protocol, TxPoW, MiniDapps and node commands, with citations.

apps.name: Minima Faucet
apps.description: Request test funds from the Minima faucet to your node's wallet address.

apps.name: miniMall
apps.description: Your shop-of-shops — add shops a vendor shares (.shop files), browse storefronts, and order with Minima or mxUSDT. End-to-end encrypted, Maxima-free.

apps.name: miniMall Inbox
apps.description: Vendor order manager — receive and manage orders across all your shops (PAID → CONFIRMED → SHIPPED), tagged by shop, with order chat + CSV export.

apps.name: miniMall Studio
apps.description: Build a shop on your phone — products, photos, shipping — keyed to your node, then export a .shop bundle to share with customers.

apps.name: miniMall Studio (Mac)
apps.description: Desktop build of miniMall Studio for macOS — downloads a .dmg (a download, not an Android install). Open it on a Mac to install.

apps.name: miniMall Studio (Windows installer)
apps.description: Desktop build of miniMall Studio for Windows — downloads a one-click installer (.exe). Run it on Windows to install (a download, not an Android install).

apps.name: miniMall Studio (Windows portable)
apps.description: Portable Windows build — downloads a standalone .exe (no install). Run it on Windows and the studio opens in your browser.

apps.name: Minima Core
apps.description: Run a full Minima Core node on Android — the node the companion apps connect to. (If you already run a node, you may already have this installed.)

apps.name: Minima Core — New UI (Preview)
apps.description: Minima Core with eurobuddha's brand-native dark-first UI restyle PLUS the H2 node fix (2.4.240 crashed on Android's verifier). Resources + one dependency line; installs manually over the official build (back up your seed first).

apps.name: Minima Terminal
apps.description: Run Minima Core node commands from a full on-device terminal, backed by your local node.

apps.name: Minima Wallet
apps.description: Self-custodial Minima wallet — signs locally, uses Minima Core only as a NON-admin relay (works with node admin OFF). PRE-VERIFICATION TEST BUILD: viewing balances + receiving is safe; do NOT send real funds until on-device verification confirms a transaction lands on-chain. Coins received are always recoverable from your seed. When importing a seed, enter how many signatures it has already used (over-estimate if unsure) — this protects against reusing a one-time key.

apps.name: FreezePeach
apps.description: Censorship-resistant, self-custodial chat on the MaxLite off-chain network. Your identity is your Minima seed — the same on any device — end-to-end sealed, no phone number, no account, no server that can read or block you. Premium two-theme design, scan/paste contacts, short IDs, group chats with media + admins, rich sealed photos/video, and a full photo editor: filters, adjust, crop, rotate, markup, plus a native retro-effects studio (filtr, ported to OpenGL ES): dithering & palettes, halftone, edge-detect, ASCII art, CRT, scanlines, RGB-split, bloom, grain. Now includes a full non-custodial in-app Minima wallet: local WOTS signing (seed never leaves the device), send to any address or straight to a contact from the chat with a payment bubble, token icons + names + web-validation checkmarks, and a live balance.

apps.name: PandaPools
apps.description: Constant-product AMM liquidity pools on Minima — swap MINIMA/token across aggregated micro-pools, provide liquidity and earn the 0.5% swap fee. Trustless VERIFYOUT covenant; pools are good-till-cancelled and discovered from a shared on-chain registry. Interoperable with the PandaPools MiniDapp (same pools).
